facts.text: The House of Dynasties is a one-star restaurant in the Michelin Guide Beijing 2025-2026.
facts.excerpt: One star restaurant by Michelin Guide Beijing 2025-2026

facts.text: The House of Dynasties serves Cantonese dim sum in a grand dynastic setting.
facts.excerpt: Steaming hot Cantonese dim sum served in a grand dynastic setting.

facts.text: At The House of Dynasties, Zhanjiang flavours are prepared with seasonal, sustainably sourced ingredients.
facts.excerpt: At The House of Dynasties, humble Zhanjiang flavours are elevated through seasonal, sustainably‑sourced ingredients

facts.text: Country Kitchen is a Michelin-selected restaurant in the Michelin Guide Beijing 2024-2026.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-selected restaurant by Michelin Guide Beijing 2024-2026

facts.text: Country Kitchen serves Northern Chinese cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Taste the delicacies of Northern Chinese Cuisine in a sophisticated setting.

facts.text: Red Bowl is a hot pot restaurant where guests can eat at the bar or in a private room.
facts.excerpt: A fresh bounty of meats, seafood, and vegetables. Enjoy at the bar or in a private room.

facts.text: Butterfly Patisserie serves fresh pastries and cakes during the day and cocktails at night.
facts.excerpt: Serving fresh pastries and cakes throughout the day, and sophisticated cocktails at night.

facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool with jacuzzi access, views and curated art.
facts.excerpt: immerse yourself in the 830-square-meter heated indoor pool with jacuzzi access, stunning views, and curated art.

facts.text: The spa is Sense, A Rosewood Spa, which offers a Sand and Wood Massage based on Beijing's pat therapy massage.
facts.excerpt: Beijing’s famous “pat therapy” massage stimulates acupressure points to improve blood flow.

facts.text: The hotel offers a 798 Contemporary Art Tour exploring Beijing's contemporary art galleries.
facts.excerpt: Explore Beijing’s flourishing contemporary art galleries in this inspiring community.

facts.text: The Rosewood Suite has a living room, an enclosed bedroom and a half bath.
facts.excerpt: A warm and serene suite offering an elegantly furnished living room, enclosed bedroom and half bath.

facts.text: Guest rooms combine traditional materials with modern design.
facts.excerpt: Sanctuaries of stillness and style where traditional materials meet modern design in the heart of the city

facts.text: Dark woods, curated art and shelves of curios and books give the hotel the feel of a private residence.
facts.excerpt: Dark woods, curated art, and shelves filled with curios and books give Rosewood Beijing the feeling of a sophisticated private residence rather than a typical high-rise luxury hotel.

facts.text: The design balances contemporary style with subtle references to Chinese craftsmanship and history.
facts.excerpt: balancing contemporary design with subtle references to Chinese craftsmanship and history

facts.text: Guest rooms have marble bathrooms, deep soaking tubs and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: with marble bathrooms, deep soaking tubs, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city skyline

facts.text: The hotel is at Jing Guang Centre, Hu Jia Lou, Beijing.
facts.excerpt: Hu Jia Lou Jing Guang Centre, Beijing 100020

facts.text: Guest rooms are exceptionally spacious by Beijing standards.
facts.excerpt: Guest rooms are exceptionally spacious by Beijing standards

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the landmark of contemporary Beijing.
